sentence: I have never eat sushi before.
ruleVi: Hiện tại hoàn thành: have/has + quá khứ phân từ (V3); eat → eaten.

sentence: She has visit Da Nang three times.
ruleVi: Sau has phải là quá khứ phân từ: visit → visited.

sentence: Have you ever see a panda?
ruleVi: Câu hỏi trải nghiệm Have you ever + V3; see → seen (không dùng saw).

sentence: My brother have lost his phone again.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ số ít (my brother) dùng has + V3.

sentence: We has finished our homework, so we can play now.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ we/you/they/I dùng have + V3.

sentence: Lan has wrote three emails this morning.
ruleVi: Sau has dùng quá khứ phân từ: write → written, không dùng quá khứ đơn wrote.

sentence: They have just buy a new house in Hanoi.
Has your father ever drove a truck?
The children have broke the window.
ruleVi: Have + V3: break → broken (broke là quá khứ đơn).

sentence: Did you ever been to Hue?
ruleVi: Hỏi trải nghiệm dùng hiện tại hoàn thành: Have you ever been ...?
